Assurance regime; jurisdiction US

Aircraft certification

Delegation of certification to the regulated firm's own staff (ODA) is the closest analogue to labs running their own safety cases. The 737 MAX reforms show delegation can be reclaimed.

Payer, access, publication

Who pays. Manufacturer pays for certification work, much of it delegated to its own employees.
Access. Regulator has statutory access; delegation reduces what it inspects directly.
Publication. Type certificates public; findings largely internal.
